$comment: Single source of truth for every public version, artifact and platform reference. Documentation and the website are checked against this file (scripts/check-docs.py) and the website download block is rendered from it (scripts/render-release-refs.py). Change it only together with a release; never edit a hash by hand, compute it from the published artifact. The release reference is the tag: a commit hash is deliberately absent, because this file ships inside the release commit and cannot name that commit's own hash. Consumers resolve the tag (F-Droid records its own resolved hash in fdroiddata).

fdroid.note: The 3.0.16 entry is submitted to fdroiddata and pins the release commit; F-Droid's build of it is pending. 3.0.15 was added to fdroiddata by F-Droid's update bot and has not been built yet; 3.0.14 and 3.0.11 were disabled after their builds failed on F-Droid's server.
